senses.definition: Half of the way between two points.
examples: I was already halfway home when I missed my keyring.
One day has gone by and she's already halfway through the book.
It's July 1st, so this year is halfway over.

quotes.text: Just over halfway up, we reached the Human settlement with its houses of stone and wood and thatch.
quotes.reference: 1989, Octavia E. Butler, “Part III, Chapter 7”, in Imago, page 210:

quotes.text: "He comes halfway and I come halfway," said Mr. Korson, 56.
quotes.reference: 2010 March 25, Corey Kilgannon, “When Meeting Halfway Means in the Street”, in The New York Times, archived from the original on 18 Sep 2024:

quotes.text: For Super Bowl visitors, Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens lies about halfway between the Miami and Fort Lauderdale airports.
quotes.reference: 2020 January 7, Rebecca Wallwork, “Which South Florida airport should I fly into?”, in CNN:

examples: a halfway decent place to sleep

senses.definition: Middle; midway; being in the middle of the way or distance.
examples: John blacked out at the halfway point of the marathon.
